newsitem.title: POLAND: Swarzedz sees east exports doubling in '97.
newsitem.headline: Swarzedz sees east exports doubling in '97.

text.p: Polish furniture maker Swarzedz SA has signed a cooperation agreement with Russian furniture retailer San Leonarda Foggia (SLF), which would help the firm double its export to the East, Swarzedz's spokesman said.
Sebastian Szczesny told Reuters the agreement was likely to increase Swarzedz's eastern exports to eight percent of total production in 1997 from the current four percent.
"We think the agreement will help us increase our exports to the East," he said, adding that Swarzedz already had a furniture show room in Moscow.
Swarzedz saw its overall exports in 1997 at 65 percent of its expected 170 million-zloty-sales .

Swarzedz, which according to preliminary figures, had a net loss of 38.6 million zlotys in 1996, expected a council of all the firm's creditors to decide on a debt restructuring plan in the next few weeks.
Szczesny also said Swarzedz had shed off six out of its five fully-owned trading firms, dealing with its distribution in Poland.
He said the move was likely to help the company improve distribution and managing of the firms.
